capabilities: Read Markdown notes, text PDFs and local HTML aloud
Navigate document outlines and read sections
Highlight the current passage during playback
Configure system, online or self-hosted speech voices
Export online-engine reading ranges as WAV files
extras: Mobile-focused companion to a separate desktop edition; physical-device validation for several features is still pending, and OCR, background playback and OpenAI Realtime are marked experimental.
problem: Obsidian on phones and tablets has no built-in way to read notes, PDFs or local HTML aloud with controllable voices and playback.
